project.title: Screen Sidekick
project.tagline: A Rust + GPUI screenshot utility for capture, preview, annotation, and export workflows.

summary.short: Screen Sidekick is a macOS-first Rust + GPUI screenshot utility with portable core boundaries for capture, preview stacks, annotation, and future Windows support.
summary.long: Milestones M0-M3 are complete, covering capture-to-overlay, tray and hotkeys, capture modes, native macOS window behavior, and the annotation foundation. M4 advanced annotation is in progress with blur/pixelate and highlight dimmer complete; PNG/JPEG export, JPEG quality controls, clipboard render, and Quick Save remain to be completed.

highlights: Fullscreen, focused-window, chooser, and interactive area capture
Tray, configurable global hotkeys, preview stack, and clipboard/delete actions
Annotation foundation plus blur/pixelate and highlight dimmer
macOS-first with Windows planned after product stabilization
